text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"complete introductory claim followed by developed paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"It presents ideas in a clearer overall structure with an introduction, supporting paragraphs, and a conclusion-like ending."},{"evidence":"more sustained explanation of positive attitude and its effects","quality":"development","description":"It expands on its main point with several related explanations instead of mostly brief assertions."},{"evidence":"logical connectors such as \"because,\" \"also,\" \"if,\" and \"for example\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"It uses linking words more effectively to connect ideas within and across sentences."},{"evidence":"sentences like \"It brings optimism into your life\" and \"If this attitude is strong enough, it becomes contagious\"","quality":"sentence fluency","description":"It shows more control of sentence flow and variety, making the writing easier to follow."},{"evidence":"words and phrases like \"optimism,\" \"constructive changes,\" \"perspective,\" and \"responsibility\"","quality":"vocabulary control","description":"It uses a broader range of more precise academic vocabulary to express ideas."},{"evidence":"fewer disruptive errors in word forms and spelling across the essay","quality":"mechanical accuracy","description":"It has somewhat better control of spelling and basic written conventions, even though errors remain."}]}
